title: アドバンスドマニュファクチャリングⅠ
subtitle: Advanced Manufacturing I
keywords: Machining methods 2.Machine tools 3.Cutting theory 4.Cutting tool and tool damage 5.Dimensional and shape accuracy
educationalGoal: (1) learn the functions and structures of various machine tools (2) learn how to select an advantageous machining method for the requirements under the basic production manufacturing technology (3) Learn the basic theory of removal machining (4) Learn how to select cutting tool materials and cutting conditions (5) Learn measurement methods to evaluate the required precision
advice: This class will cover the following topics: 1. Outline of manufacturing technology(Trends in machining Technology, Classification of fundamental machining methods 2. Fundamentals of cutting theory (Chip Formation and shear mechanism, Cutting force and cutting temperature) 3. Fundamental machining methods (Function and structure of milling machines, Lathes, Drilling machines, etc., Selection of cutting conditions) 4. NC machine tools (Functions and structure of CNC Lathes, Machining Centers, Multi-tasking machine tool, etc.) 5. Cutting tools and tool damage (Various tool materials, Understanding tool damage and Product accuracy, etc.) 6. Workpiece evaluation methods (Dimensional accuracy, Geometric accuracy, Surface roughness)
books: Textbooks: Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to watch videos on machining methods and the functions of machine tools. This will help you understand actual machine motion and machining systems. It is also important to experience the actual machining process by visiting processing plants and industrial fairs. Obtaining a license for Yumekobo machine tools and actually operating them is useful for deepening your understanding.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the functions and structure of various machine tools
Be able to understand basic manufacturing methods
Be able to understand the basics of cutting theory
Be able to understand the types of cutting tool materials and their effective use
Be able to understand the measurement methods used to verify the required accuracy

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Fully understand the functions and structures of various machine tools. (2) Explain basic manufacturing methods correctly. (3) A two-dimensional cutting model and the theoretical mechanism of shearing can be explained using figures. (4) The damage classification of cutting tools and its cause can be explained in detail. (5) Explain the measurement method to accurately verify the accuracy required for the machined parts.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the functions and structures of various machine tools. (2) Explain basic manufacturing methods. (3) A two-dimensional cutting model and the theoretical mechanism of shear can be explained. (4) The types and causes of cutting tool damage can be explained. (5) Explain the measurement method to verify the specified dimensions of machined parts.
